title: Makepad: Designing modern UIs with Rust - Rik Arends - RustNL 2023
summary: Rik Arends presents Makepad, a Rust UI framework, at RustNL 2023. The talk covers designing modern, GPU-fast UIs with Rust and includes live-coded demos of an IDE and a synthesizer.
why: HN commenters recommend it for the live-coded demos running at high frame rates, calling the performance impressive.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Greg Johnston, creator of Leptos, has made a video with performance comparisons
